Subject: Follow-up: Budget range + model mix (pricing & volume ask)

Hi Liam — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored pricing scenario: 

Call summary (very quick):
- Use case: in-product assistant + semantic search for enterprise KB; low-latency chat for support routing, embeddings for search, reranker for answer quality.
- Primary traffic: support chat during EU daytime; periodic bulk embeddings jobs for indexing; rerank executed as a post-filter for top-5.

What we need from you (3 quick datapoints so we can model cost):
1) Target monthly token volume (gross) for chat (prompt+completion) — ballpark is fine (e.g., 50M / 200M / 1B tokens).
2) Monthly document-embedding units (approx number of documents per month or embedding calls).
3) Expected % of requests that use rerank vs. total queries (e.g., 15% of queries run rerank).
4) Annual or monthly budget range you’re comfortable with for hosted inference (if you prefer Dedicated we can contrast).

For reference, a sample target unit we often use for decisioning: $/1M tokens (hosted) and a blended $/1M tokens assuming model mix. If you can share ballpark volumes, I’ll return two scenarios: (A) hosted with typical discounts for 6–12mo usage, and (B) committed Reserved (Dedicated) estimate with unit-price improvements.

Thanks — if easier, reply in the thread with the three numbers and I’ll run the math and share a short table. Happy to hop on 20–30m next week if you prefer to walk through.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Jonas — thanks for the clear note. Apologies for the delay, been pulling numbers together. Ballpark from our side: 

- Chat: ~180,000,000 tokens / month (mix of short prompts + generated replies, avg 120 tokens per interaction).
- Embeddings: roughly 600k embedding calls / month (we reindex portions of KB weekly + user-driven similarity calls).
- Rerank: approximately 12% of user queries (~user queries ~1.5M/mo, so rerank ~180k calls).
- Budget: initial year we can target €40–€70k / month for inference depending on unit pricing. We could consider a 12-month commit if we see predictable savings at the unit level.

Key constraints: EU data residency required; low single-digit second median latency for chat is important. If you can show a couple of price scenarios (hosted vs. dedicated) that map to a blended $/1M tokens, that would be super helpful.

— Liam

Ava Solutions

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Budget range + model mix (pricing & volume ask)

Hi Liam — great, thanks for the numbers — super helpful. I ran two quick scenarios below (very high level) and attached a sample sheet with the line-item math. See attached: redwood-pricing-sheet-20260721.xlsx.

RECAP of your inputs (we used these to model):
- Chat tokens: 180M / month
- Embeddings: 600k calls / month
- Rerank calls: 180k / month
- Region: EU, data residency required

Scenario A — Hosted (pay-as-you-go / standard volume tiers):
- Chat: assumed model = gpt-4o-lite-chat (mix), effective unit ~ $1,200 / 1M tokens (this is illustrative; exact depends on prompt/completion split and model variant).
- Embeddings: $150 / 1M embedding calls equivalent (embeddings priced per call; converted in sheet)
- Rerank: priced as model-inference calls, assume $350 / 1M tokens equivalent for reranker ops.
- Blended unit (hosted) ≈ $820 / 1M tokens -> Monthly spend ≈ $147.6k (note: this is un-discounted/illustrative).

Scenario B — Committed Reserved (12mo Dedicated) with 30% unit improvement assumption:
- Blended unit ≈ $574 / 1M tokens -> Monthly spend ≈ $103.3k; plus a small infra premium for EU private control plane when requested.

What this tells us: your stated budget range (€40–€70k/mo) is below the basic hosted blended estimate for 180M tokens at typical model choices. To reach your budget band we can: 
- Reduce model mix to favor smaller/quantized chat models for non-critical flows, and run rerank as an on-demand fallback (reduces average token cost).
- Implement prefix caching and inference-level batching to reduce effective tokens served (Redwood Optimize suggestions).
- Agree a 12mo commit with a higher percentage discount (or volume tiering) to bring blended unit down closer to your band.

Proposed next steps (pick any):
1) I’ll prepare two formal quotes: a) Hosted with tiered pricing and clear $/1M tokens for each model; b) Dedicated 12mo commit with target blended $/1M tokens and SLA.
2) If you want to explore hitting €40–€70k/mo, we can model the specific model mix (e.g., 60% small chat, 30% embeddings, 10% rerank) to show how that impacts quality vs. cost.
3) Quick tech sync with our Solutions Engineer to validate latency/residency options and confirm caching opportunities.

If you’re open to a short call tomorrow, I can walk through the attached sheet and show levers we commonly use to move blended cost. Otherwise I’ll produce the two quote variants and the model-mix sensitivity table.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet-20260721.xlsx (Excel)]

Proposal I want to send back (need your thumbs up):
- Offer both: Hosted quote (standard tiers) and a 12mo Dedicated commit option.
- For Dedicated 12mo: propose a blended unit at $520 / 1M tokens (approx 35–40% off our standard hosted blend) if they commit to 12mo and a min monthly spend of €75k (close to their upper band). Include an escalation clause if usage ramps beyond 250M tokens/mo.
- Also propose a staged roll-out: Month 1–2 = evaluation (hosted), Month 3–12 = Dedicated cutover if latency and quality validated.

Questions for you:
1) Is $520 / 1M tokens a defensible committed price for this account in EU with data-residency and required SLA?
2) Any constraints on offering the min monthly spend / is €75k acceptable as a threshold?
3) I'll attach a Statement of Activity (SoA) and formal quote once you confirm.

Attached for context: redwood-pricing-sheet-20260721.xlsx; I plan to attach a SoA / Commit PDF after approval.
